items.summary: Stock futures are lower as investors take profits following Monday’s powerful technology-led rebound. Nvidia is back under pressure after surging 31% Monday, adding nearly $1T to its market capitalization. Shares are down approximately 4% pre-market, while Micron, AMD and Marvell are also declining. items.summary: Investing.com -- Medtronic PLC (MDT) reported FY2027 Q2 on Nov 24, 2026. Adjusted EPS was $1.34 vs $1.33 expected, but revenue of $9.40B missed the $9.48B estimate. The stock was $97.30 (-3.4%) as of 12:56 PM EST, after a pre-market print of $96.59. The 52-week range is $73.31–$106.33.

items.title: Can Boston Scientific Stock Rise 30% From Here?
items.summary: Boston Scientific still has a business growing fast, yet its share price appears to treat the whole company as stalled. That business is interventional cardiology, which treats blocked heart arteries. On its October 28 call, the company said the unit grew 19% from a year earlier in the third quarter. Total company sales grew only 1.4% in that quarter.
